issues.body:
Hi there,

I ported the mod to 26.3; Since you normally create a new branch for each Minecraft version and there isn't an upstream 26.3 branch yet, my changes are currently on [EastArctica/Enchantment-Descriptions:26.3](https://github.com/EastArctica/Enchantment-Descriptions/tree/26.3), based on your 26.2 branch.

Could you create the 26.3 branch so I can open the PR against it or otherwise pull in the 26.3 changes?

Thanks! ❤️

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.21.11

### Mod Version

21.11.1

### Mod Loader

Fabric

### What environment are you running the mod in?

Dedicated Server

### Issue Description

### **Description**

When running Enchantment Descriptions on a Fabric server, items intermittently receive additional item components:

- minecraft:lore
- minecraft:tooltip_display

These components are sometimes present and sometimes absent on otherwise identical items, which causes them to not stack.

### **Impact**

This affects all item types, including completely vanilla items (e.g., apples, planks, sticks), even when they are:

- freshly crafted
- freshly dropped/picked up
- generated via /give

As a result:

- identical items cannot stack
- inventory management becomes severely degraded

**### Reproduction Steps**

1. Install Enchantment Descriptions on a Fabric server (Minecraft 1.21.11)
2. Start server with no other gameplay-altering mods (or minimal mod set)
3. Obtain two identical items (e.g., apples or planks) via:

- - - crafting, or
- - - /give

4. Attempt to stack them

**### Observed Behavior**

Items fail to stack.
Running: /data get entity @e[type=item,limit=1,sort=nearest]
Shows inconsistent components:
Example 1: Item: {id:"minecraft:apple", count:1}
Example 2: Item: {
  id:"minecraft:apple",
  count:1,
  components:{
    "minecraft:tooltip_display":{},
    "minecraft:lore":()
  }
}

**### Expected Behavior**

Identical items should stack normally.
The mod should:

- either not add these components to non-enchanted items
- or apply them consistently so items remain stackable

**### Environment**

- Minecraft: 1.21.11
- Loader: Fabric
- Mod: Enchantment Descriptions (enchantment-fabric-1.21.11-1.0.0.jar)
- Server type: Dedicated server

**### Additional Notes**

- Issue persists with freshly created items
- Removing the mod immediately resolves the issue
- Other mods affecting item entities were disabled during testing (e.g., Jade, ServerCore, getittogetherdrops)

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.21.1

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Feedback

It looks like at one point, it was possible via the config to set an indent size for how much the description will be indented compared to the enchantment name : #117

However, nowadays, there is only a prefix string available.
This may look alright for shorter descriptions, but if it is two lines or longer, as expected, the prefix will only be applied to the first line.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7eb7a361-2add-406c-842c-d88475eab65a)

This does not look good and is not a perfect replacement to the previously mentionned indent size config, even though the comment in the config file says that the prefix config should be used to add indents.

I'm proposing to add back the previous indent size config.

Thank you for your time !

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is not working as intended.

labels.name: verified
labels.description: The contents of this issue have been verified and a fix is planned.

issues.body:
### Minecraft Version

1.16.5

### Mod Version

7.1.25

### Mod Loader

Forge

### What environment are you running the mod in?

Client

### Issue Description

Someone has reported a key prompt display issue when using this mod with my [Key Binding Patch](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/key-binding-patch) mod. Original issue is here: https://github.com/Giant-Salted-Fish/Key-Binding-Patch/issues/6.

I have reviewed the code of this mod and the cause is here:

https://github.com/Darkhax-Minecraft/Enchantment-Descriptions/blob/25f4deaf94b4f17a0cc040ac066a7dcc0068fbfc/src/main/java/net/darkhax/enchdesc/EnchantmentDescriptionsClient.java#L80

Although it is called `KeyBinding#getTranslationKey()` in `mcp` mapping, it is actually called `KeyBinding#saveString()` in `official` mapping. And this method is not suitable to retrieve localized key display name because it only returns the key code of the key binding without the modifiers.

Appropriate method to use here is `KeyBinding#func_238171_j_()`, which has corresponding name `KeyBinding#getTranslatedKeyMessage()` in `official` mapping. It returns a `ITextComponent` instance that contains the right localized display string of the binding key. It is also the method that being used in the `ControlsScreen` to display the key of the key binding.

Hence replace `I18n.format(this.keybind.getTranslationKey())` with `this.keybind.func_238171_j_().getString()` should be able to fix this issue.

Thank you for reviewing!
